name: fatfish-watermark
description: Replace electerm's default terminal watermark with a theme-aware 大肥鱼 (DeepSeek whale-girl) line-art watermark.
author: ZHAO Xudong

electerm.name: Fatfish Terminal Watermark
electerm.description: Replace the default electerm watermark with a 大肥鱼 / DeepSeek whale-girl line drawing that follows your theme's text colour, so it stays visible on dark, light and coloured backgrounds.

configs.name: opacity
configs.label: Opacity (%)
configs.description: How strong the watermark is, in percent. Clamped to 5–60. The default, 20, is about as subtle as electerm's built-in wordmark.

configs.name: size
configs.label: Height (%)
configs.description: Watermark height as a percent of the terminal pane. Clamped to 30–95; the width follows the artwork's aspect ratio.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Apply on launch
configs.description: Re-apply on every launch. This is the switch that puts the widget in electerm's auto-run list.
